annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses identify the same operational hazard: a potential cold-chain/temperature excursion despite conflicting device readings. Each considers uncertainty, the possibility of product quality impact versus a sensor/device issue, and the time-sensitive nature of the shipment. Each also proposes proportionate action: verify/reconcile readings, check excursion details and device status, escalate if the excursion appears meaningful or product risk is real, and document/proceed cautiously if the issue is minor or attributable to equipment. The differences are mostly in wording and level of detail, not in decision-relevant evidence or operational commitment.
